release_authorization.statement: ok, go through and do all that, and then create a draft release notes and I will hand write them myself
release_authorization.scope: Owner instruction to merge, record acceptance, open and merge the PR, tag and create a draft release with the disclosed pending live coverage below. Publication of the draft remains owner-controlled.

pending: Physical touch press, cancellation, long press, rotation, portrait/landscape and accessibility; touch overlay and keyboard layering.
Real OmaTouch and Tablet Mode keyboard operations, provider loss/recovery, app text entry and Wi-Fi password entry.
Real window restoration/movement/close, brightness/audio/media and rotation controls from the touch home.
Physical extra mouse button (the gesture was exercised with a virtual pointer).
ARM64/iPad mini 4 graphics, touch mapping and end-to-end tablet acceptance.
Secure keyboard-free login, suspend/wake and unlock; inspected Omarchy lock view has no on-screen keyboard.
Launches of agents other than Codex; Oma-Cast dismissal/focus handoff and the custom-icon file chooser.
Live runs used earlier dev/0.4 commits; the agent-mark change (ActionIcon.qml, Model.js, scripts/agents) was verified live by screenshot only, and the merge changed only workflows, tests and docs.
known_issues: Omarchy's setEnabled(false) removes only one of a plugin's shell.json entries; with both a bar entry and a plugins[] record Orb stays loaded after Disable. A second disable works around it.
limitations: Qt event tests use real Qt input delivery with theme/UI stubs, not Quickshell, the Omarchy shell, or real keyboard providers.
Helper tests replace IPC commands with controlled fixtures; source inspection is not native integration acceptance.
Automatic mode requires enabled Tablet Mode and a definite folded observation from a real fold sensor. Persistent Touch is the choice for tablets without one.
Normal overlay keyboards cannot provide secure lock-screen input. No authentication bypass is implemented.
No claim of official Omarchy tablet-default adoption, confirmed iPad support, marketplace approval or security audit.
No v0.4.0 release authorization for pending-live gaps has been recorded. The branch remains a draft candidate.
review_notes: v0.4.0 merges the published desktop-only v0.3.0 and keeps touch navigation; named wheels, transfers, work setups and window pairs remain deferred.
